page-structure.evidence: No <nav> landmark exists anywhere on the page (hasNav:false); landmarks are [main, 5×aside, footer]. The site header contains navigation links (RT App, News, Showtimes, Movies, TV) but uses no <nav> element or role='navigation', leaving those links inaccessible to landmark navigation. Additionally, the heading hierarchy starts at h2 with no h1 present (axe page-has-heading-one, best-practice). All 39 headings are h2/h3/h4 with no h1; heading levels skip from h3 directly to h4 inside the cookie-opt-out section. Title is descriptive ('Rotten Tomatoes: Movies | TV Shows | Movie Trailers | Reviews | Rotten Tomatoes') — 2.4.2 passes. 5 unlabelled <aside> landmarks lack distinguishing labels (landmark-complementary-is-top-level, region axe).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 28 lists have list-style:none applied without explicit role='list' (listStyleNone:28). In Safari/VoiceOver this strips list semantics, making navigation lists and movie carousels read as flat ungrouped content (1.3.1, WebKit-specific). Tab order is disrupted by the ad-unit iframe keyboard trap: global tabWalk reaches only 4 stops (skip link → ad iframe ×3) before cycling, making the correct sequential focus order unverifiable beyond those stops. Reading order within the footer and carousel sections appears consistent with DOM order where reachable.

reflow.evidence: At 320×900 viewport: scrollWidth=320, clientWidth=320, ratio=1.0, bodyLen=6519. Page reflows to a single column with no horizontal overflow. 1.4.10 passes.
